clues.text: After leaving Athens, the apostle Paul traveled on to this Greek city.
Here Paul found Aquila and his wife Priscilla, who had recently come from Italy after Claudius ordered Jews out of Rome.
In this city a crowd beat Sosthenes the synagogue leader before the judgment seat, but Gallio did not care.
After staying here a long while, Paul had his head shaved at Cenchrea to keep a vow and sailed for Syria.
Apollos was staying in this city while Paul traveled through the interior and came to Ephesus.
A letter was addressed to the church of God in this city, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy.
Paul called God as his witness that he did not return to this city in order to spare the believers there.
